in_marathi.name: Shaambhavyani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shaambhavyani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Shambhavi embodies the essence of grace, compassion, and inner peace. She is a powerful deity revered for her nurturing and calming presence. Her blessings are sought for a peaceful and harmonious life.
